claims: Justin Fairfax served as Virginia Lieutenant Governor from 2018 to 2022.
Justin Fairfax faced sexual assault allegations in 2019 from Vanessa Tyson and Meredith Watson.
Justin Fairfax denied the claims, alleging the encounters were consensual.
Vanessa Tyson alleged that in 2004, Justin Fairfax forced her to perform oral sex in a hotel room during the Democratic National Convention in Boston.
Meredith Watson alleged that Justin Fairfax raped her in 2000 while they were both students at Duke University.
Justin Fairfax finished in 4th place in the 2021 Democratic gubernatorial primary.
On April 16, 2026, police reported that Justin Fairfax killed his wife, Cerina Fairfax, and then himself at their Virginia home amid a "complicated" divorce.
